newsitem.title: USA: Hummer Winblad raises $100 mln, adds Bill Gurley.
newsitem.headline: Hummer Winblad raises $100 mln, adds Bill Gurley.

text.p: Hummer Winblad Venture Partners said Monday it has named software analyst Bill Gurley as a partner and raised $100 million for a new fund devoted to software investments.

Gurley was previously a highly regarded Internet research analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) Technology Group in Menlo Park, Calif. He has also worked at CS First Boston, Compaq Computer Corp, and Advanced Micro Devices Inc. In a news release computer industry leaders, including Microsoft Corp. CEO Bill Gates, lauded Gurley for his insights into Internet technology and strategy.
The firm also announced the creation of Hummer Winblad Venture Partners III, the third fund created by partners John Hummer, Ann Winblad and Mark Gorenberg.

The venture firm's first fund was created in 1989 and raised $35 million, subsequently returning $250 million to investors. With the creation of Fund III, the partners now manage $200 million targeted for software companies. ((sam.perry@reuters.com, Palo Alto Bureau 415 846 5400))
